name: Event-driven classify, route, verify, learn harness
summary: Ingest event, fetch context, classify, map each class to a fixed allowed action (blast radius set by path not model), execute deterministic workflow, call LLM only where needed, run end hooks, verify, update state, feed back learnings.
steps: Ingest | Classify | Map class to fixed action | Deterministic execution, LLM for judgment | End hooks | Verify and learn
jarvis_use: Jarvis's loop classifies each request, routes to a stored procedure with a fixed allowed action, verifies, then writes back.

name: Rails first, AI last mile
summary: Wireframe boxes with simple statuses, build deterministic rails (status tracking, reminders, escalation, unique key) first, then add the model at the one generative/judgment step; fewer AI steps means less testing and cost.
steps: Wireframe boxes and statuses | Build deterministic rails | Human escalation | Add AI at last mile only | Test across runs
jarvis_use: When Jarvis plans an automation it routes rule-like steps to scripts/filters and calls a model only for the judgment step.

name: Orchestration shape catalog
summary: Pick a named shape per task: solo loop (default), maker-checker, manager+helpers, classify-and-act, fan-out-and-synthesize, adversarial review, generate-and-filter, tournament, loop-until-done; any multi-model plan names the assignee per subtask and the combiner.
steps: Match task to shape | Name assignee per subtask | Name combiner | Add checker when grading is unreliable
jarvis_use: Jarvis defaults to solo and adds a checker for high-stakes output; fan-out plans name assignee and combiner.

name: Sub-agents vs agent teams
summary: Sub-agents report only to the main session and cannot talk to each other; teams can debate to consensus but cost much more.
steps: Sub-agents for independent parallel work | Teams only for consensus | Account for cost
jarvis_use: Hub-and-spoke by default; debate only when a decision needs it.

name: Harness above agents (workflow engine decides when the LLM runs)
summary: A workflow engine (YAML/code, e.g. Archon) owns orchestration and invokes the LLM only at marked steps; subagents exchange markdown contracts; an observability board tracks runs; exposed as CLI plus a skill.
steps: Define workflow as code/YAML | Mark LLM steps | Markdown contracts between workers | Log runs | Expose via CLI + skill
jarvis_use: Encode repeatable Jarvis jobs as scripted pipelines with LLM calls only at judgment steps, logged per run.

name: Deploy chooser: live operator vs scheduled script
summary: Place each job on where it runs (machine vs cloud) and how deterministic (agent loop vs script); check which WAT parts it carries and whether machine/session must stay on. Self-healing exists only in live agent sessions; deployed scripts log failures for a supervised repair.
steps: Must it survive machine off? | Needs agent or script? | Interval? | Pick host | Route failures to a supervised session
jarvis_use: Before any recurring job, Jarvis fills where/determinism/WAT/machine-on/session-on and picks the lightest host.

name: Async submit then poll
summary: Create returns a ticket/task ID; wait an initial interval, GET status by ID, dedupe/limit the response, loop on a short interval tuned to real latency until terminal state, then fetch the artifact; add a max-attempt cap.
steps: POST create, capture ID | Initial wait | GET status by ID | Dedupe | Loop with cap until terminal | Fetch result
tools: n8n Wait/If/Limit, FAL.ai, Vapi API, Kie.ai
jarvis_use: Standard poller for renders, builds, ASR and agent runs in Jarvis background jobs.

name: Gather, then per-item act (fan-out/fan-in)
summary: A finder task gathers items and triggers one writer run per item so a failed write retries alone; Split Out to per-item processing and Aggregate back to one item before the final step.
steps: Gather items | One act per item | Retry failed item alone | Aggregate before final step
tools: trigger.dev, n8n Split Out, n8n Aggregate
jarvis_use: Jarvis jobs gather then act per item with per-item logging and retry, combining before the final output.

name: Off-window tool output
summary: Route large payloads through a CLI that stores/mirrors raw results locally and returns only a short formatted summary to the agent context.
steps: CLI calls remote | Store raw locally | Return short summary | Compare wire vs context tokens
jarvis_use: Jarvis tool wrappers write raw responses to disk and return summaries; complements lean screenshot context.

name: Brittle capabilities as typed standalone tools (paths not bytes)
summary: Wrap capabilities (image gen, edits, posting) as separate subflows/scripts with declared inputs, reusable by any agent; pass only small variables (IDs, prompts), and let the subflow handle binary I/O.
steps: Build capability as own workflow/script | Declare typed inputs | Handle binary inside | Return path/ID | Debug via sub-execution
jarvis_use: Heavy media/file tools return file paths or IDs, never raw bytes, through the Jarvis loop.

name: Schema-validated structured outputs
summary: When model output feeds later steps, require a JSON schema (structured output parser / vendor structured outputs) instead of a prose blob; downstream maps separate fields.
steps: Define schema | Enable required output format | Validate | Retry on miss
tools: n8n Structured Output Parser, Vapi structured outputs
jarvis_use: Every Jarvis model step that feeds a tool gets a schema; reject or retry on a miss.

name: MCP discover, read schema, call, verify
summary: Client searches workflows/tools, reads required fields, executes with payload, then verifies the side effect in the target system.
steps: Search tools | Read details/schema | Execute | Verify on real surface
jarvis_use: Jarvis's MCP use follows discover-schema-call-verify; sends stay behind approval.

name: Webhook event as pointer: wait, re-fetch, fail closed
summary: Webhook bodies often carry only an ID; wait briefly, fetch the authoritative record by ID, check required fields exist before writing, clean the payload.
steps: Read ID from event | Short wait | Fetch full record | IF fields exist | Clean and write
jarvis_use: For any event-fed ingest, Jarvis re-fetches by ID and fails closed on missing fields before writing memory.

name: No user files to third-party hosts without OK
summary: Only use approved tools for company/customer data; flag steps that publish files to public hosts (e.g. ImageBB hop) and prefer signed/temporary URLs; managed indexes store data off-box, don't dedupe, so keep an upload ledger and never upload PII.
steps: Classify data | Check tool allowlist | Prefer private/temporary URLs | Ledger every external upload | Block PII
jarvis_use: Data-classification allowlist checked before any file/text leaves the Mac; public-host uploads need Evens's OK.

name: Harness-agnostic project directory (the folder is the OS)
summary: Keep instructions, skills, scripts and projects as plain files in one directory any harness (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Hermes, OpenClaw) can operate; portability test: could you switch vendor in about an hour.
steps: Tool-neutral files | Instruction files describing layout | Point multiple harnesses at it | Run the portability test
tools: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Hermes, OpenClaw
jarvis_use: Jarvis procedures, memory and routing live in repo files, not vendor config, so models/harnesses swap without rebuild.

name: Vendor-outage fallback drill
summary: Ask whether you could keep working if your main agent/model went down; wire a second harness/model into the same directory and base the stack on what doesn't change.
steps: Ask the outage question | Wire a second route | Drill it
jarvis_use: Jev holds a tested fallback per core loop; drill a provider outage.

name: Four Cs in order: context, connections, capabilities, cadence
summary: Build an AI OS in stacked layers; each depends on the one before; don't schedule (cadence) what isn't proven in context, connections and capabilities. First two = second brain.
steps: Context | Connections | Capabilities | Cadence only after proof
jarvis_use: Readiness checklist: refuse to schedule a job whose lower layers aren't proven; score Jarvis on each C.

name: Operator habits from a leaked system prompt
summary: Recalled knowledge isn't current, so verify; a prompt implying a file exists doesn't mean it does; attempt an ambiguous ask first then ask at most one question; own errors and stay on the problem.
steps: Verify recalled facts | Check files exist | Attempt first | Ask one question | Own errors
jarvis_use: Stat files before claiming them, re-check memory facts with tools, attempt-then-one-question on vague voice asks.

name: Inject current date/time and time zone
summary: Without a clock the agent offered slots from a stale date; add now plus TZ to the prompt and re-test.
steps: Spot wrong dates | Add now + TZ | Re-run scenario
jarvis_use: Inject current ET date/time each turn; check dates first when scheduling looks wrong.

name: Reject or split asks against mission
summary: On triage, compare each spec against mission goals and non-goals; reject out-of-scope with a reason, split oversized, or ask to pair.
steps: Compare to goals/non-goals | Reject with reason | Split if too large | Offer to pair
jarvis_use: Jarvis checks asks against scope and locks and pushes back with a reason or proposes a split.

name: Global rules vs stricter unattended-mode rules + mission.md
summary: Global rules always load; factory rules (bite-size, one task at a time, no auto-commit/PR, named deploy) load only in autonomous runs; mission.md holds goals and explicit out-of-scope.
steps: Global invariants file | Factory rules file for autonomous runs | mission.md with non-goals | Load factory rules only in factory mode
jarvis_use: Layer a stricter rule file on Jarvis for unattended jobs, plus a mission file with non-goals.

name: Agent-to-agent delegation with view-only audit thread
summary: Inter-agent conversations are visible to the human read-only, and the delegate notes in its own thread that it was asked, so nothing happens in secret.
steps: Router messages specialist | Thread readable by human | Specialist replies | Receipt in main reply
jarvis_use: Log every Jarvis sub-agent handoff as a transcript file and show a 'delegated to X' receipt.

name: Headless claude -p behind a UI
summary: Dashboard buttons run Claude headlessly (claude -p with a skill prompt) in the background and show results.
steps: Wire button to shell | Run claude -p | Render result
jarvis_use: A possible sub-agent path: Jarvis background jobs as headless processes with scoped prompts.

name: Agent loop calls deterministic tools (one brain front, dumb tools back)
summary: Reach for the AI loop first but call deterministic code/workflows as tools; keep reasoning in the front agent and make backend tools single-purpose with no nested LLM; the agent orchestrates data platforms via MCP instead of their UIs.
steps: Reason in the loop | Expose one-job tools | Return short plain results
jarvis_use: Jarvis's single loop already calls shell/MCP tools; keep backend tools LLM-free.

name: Agent node spec card
summary: An agent is defined by name, instructions, chat-history toggle, model, reasoning level, tools and output format.
steps: Name | Instructions | History on/off | Model and reasoning | Tools | Output format
jarvis_use: Minimum spec card for any Jarvis sub-agent or routed model call.

name: AI systems pyramid
summary: Rank by autonomy: chatbot/skill, deterministic workflow, AI workflow, agent; risk and cost rise each level, so pick the lowest that works.
steps: Map steps | Pick lowest level that works | Gate by level
jarvis_use: Tag each Jarvis capability with its level; higher levels need more gates.

name: AIOS five layers
summary: Context, data, intelligence, automate, build, in order.
steps: Context | Data | Intelligence | Automate | Build
jarvis_use: Check context and data exist before automating or building.

name: Explicit item-count and collision rules
summary: State a burst rule (keep last, dedupe by ID, queue) instead of silently processing duplicates; prefer linear single-item flows and assert one item before any send (parallel branches once produced three emails).
steps: Pick collision rule | Prefer sequential steps | Merge to one item before send | Assert count
jarvis_use: Jarvis pipelines stay single-path and assert count before output/notify.

name: Normalize every inbound channel into one envelope
summary: Switch on input type (photo/text/form/trigger), persist attachments first, and map all paths into one standard field/object so downstream logic has one contract.
steps: Detect input type | Save attachments | Map to one field | Downstream reads only that
jarvis_use: Voice, text, screenshot and file inputs become one request object with file paths before the loop.

name: Bind routing IDs from the trigger, not the model
summary: Model fills creative fields; chat/session IDs come by expression from the trigger node.
steps: Mark creative fields model-defined | Bind IDs from trigger
jarvis_use: Session, reply channel and file IDs bound deterministically.

name: Serialize model text into JSON bodies
summary: Newlines and double quotes in agent output break JSON request bodies; escape or serialize instead of string templating.
steps: Take model output | Serialize/escape | Insert into body | Test multi-line and quoted input
jarvis_use: Build payloads with a JSON serializer in shell/Python.

name: Wire APIs from the vendor's official curl and docs
summary: Import the docs' curl into the request, then go field by field: required or optional, options, desired value; delete unused optional fields; variables before '?' go in the path, after go in query/auth.
steps: Copy docs curl | Import/convert | Annotate fields | Remove unused optionals | Path vs query check
jarvis_use: Jarvis converts the official curl mechanically and annotates fields against docs before changing values.

name: Pin model and params in the request
summary: Playground model choices don't persist to API calls and wrappers may lack new params (e.g. thinking level); set model and params explicitly and make a direct API call when a wrapper lacks them.
steps: Read docs for param | Set explicitly in body | Direct call if wrapper lacks it | Confirm response
jarvis_use: Jarvis pins model/params in config and checks docs when behavior is off.

name: Model-filled tool parameters, inspected per call
summary: Make the request body a $fromAI expression so the agent writes the query and may split a compound question into several calls; inspect each call's input when debugging.
steps: Body as expression | Run compound question | Inspect each run
jarvis_use: Retrieval as a parameterized tool; inspect traces.

name: Narrow context by key before the model
summary: Look up rows by a key (sender email) or filtered query tools before the model, instead of passing whole tables; avoids token cost and hallucination.
steps: Trigger | Get rows by key | Build prompt from match | Verify returned rows
jarvis_use: Deterministic lookup first, then model.

name: Compute numbers and dates in code
summary: Arithmetic, valuation, booking clock, TZ and notice period computed deterministically (calculator/code); the model only words the result.
steps: Extract numbers | Compute in code | Model words result
jarvis_use: Jarvis computes in Python/shell and explains.

name: Templated prompts filled per run
summary: One prompt with {{variables}} filled per call; source documents fetched each run and injected; lists formatted programmatically with separators; the user message is constructed explicitly when there's no chat trigger.
steps: Template with variables | Fetch docs per run | Format arrays in code | Define user message explicitly
jarvis_use: Jarvis prompts built from templates and re-read file references.

name: Prompts and models as keyed config
summary: Keep per-workflow model, system and user prompt in a keyed table/config looked up at runtime; use enums over free-typed slugs; private prompts stay out of shared exports; re-test instruction obedience after a model swap.
steps: Config keyed by task | Lookup at runtime | Enum values | Re-test after swap
jarvis_use: Per-task prompts and model tiers in one config Jev reads.

name: Run parameters in one config block
summary: A config node/file right after the trigger holds recipients, topics, style, query; tools stay single-purpose; secrets live only in credentials/env.
steps: Config block after trigger | Reference by variable | Secrets in env only
jarvis_use: Per-run parameters in config files so tools stay reusable.

name: Wireframe the flow before building
summary: Sketch trigger, steps, AI steps (colored), branches and dependencies on a whiteboard, then build from the diagram and derive tool list and prompt sections.
steps: Draw trigger | Draw steps, mark AI | Mark branches/dependencies | Derive tools and prompt
jarvis_use: Jarvis drafts an if-X-do-Y map (Mermaid/VectorCraft) before multi-step builds.

name: Update on a unique key
summary: Update operations match on email/phone/ID, never name; make sure every later trigger carries the key.
steps: Choose unique key | Map from trigger | Ensure later payloads carry key
jarvis_use: Key every ledger/memory update on a stable unique ID; refuse when not unique.

name: One folder per job, scratch apart
summary: Start every deliverable in a dedicated project folder; intermediates and ad-hoc scripts go to temp/; only reusable tools promote to tools/.
steps: Create job folder | Scratch to temp | Promote reusable tools
jarvis_use: Jarvis writes job outputs to one job folder and scratch to a session scratch dir.

name: Smallest fix first (collapse the workflow, check native tools)
summary: Ask what workflow the data serves and whether the step can be removed; check existing platforms/CRM native features; prefer the simplest stack before building.
steps: Why is the data pulled? | Can the step be removed? | Native/existing tool? | Then smallest build
jarvis_use: Before new code, Jarvis checks installed tools, skills and MCPs for a native fit.

name: Named reusable credential instead of inline keys
summary: Store a key once as a named credential (predefined, header Bearer, or query auth) and reuse it; turn off duplicated inline headers.
steps: Create named credential | Select on every node | Remove inline key
jarvis_use: Reference env var names only; never inline keys in scripts or configs.

name: Scoped, capped key per agent
summary: Create a separate key per agent/harness, named for purpose, with spend caps and endpoint restrictions; don't reuse another project's key.
steps: New key per agent | Name it | Cap spend | Restrict endpoints
tools: Google Cloud Console, ElevenLabs API keys
jarvis_use: Jarvis asks Evens to create least-privilege keys per capability.

name: Token-scope errors and duplicate env names
summary: When a token lacks a permission, name the missing scope, rotate to a correctly scoped token, and delete the old entry so duplicate var names don't clash.
steps: Read error | Identify scope | Evens rotates | Remove duplicate entry | Retry
jarvis_use: Name missing scope, ask Evens to rotate, check for duplicate var names.

name: Host vs container filesystem check
summary: Confirm whether the process reads config from the host or inside a container before editing.
steps: Confirm container | Get container-scoped command | Edit inside
jarvis_use: Check which filesystem a process reads before editing config.

name: Runtime inventory
summary: A manager project with one folder per agent server (host, container vs root, integrations, env location) used to debug, reboot and ask for help.
steps: Folder per runtime | Record host/port/container | Paste setup output | Use for debugging
jarvis_use: Inventory doc of runtimes Jarvis touches, env var names only.

name: Read-only security posture audit
summary: Have the agent survey the environment and propose firewall rules; schedule periodic audit reports (source also mentions attack tests, out of scope).
steps: Survey | Propose rules | Periodic report
jarvis_use: Read-only report of open ports/listeners on the Mac; no offensive testing.

name: When to split into a new agent
summary: Start with one agent; split only for different credentials/tools, separate long-term memory, or separate ongoing audience/schedule; migrate markdown skills when splitting.
steps: Different creds? | Separate memory? | Ongoing separate work? | Else keep in main
jarvis_use: Jarvis stays single-loop; split only when blast radius differs.

name: Occupy/release lock on scarce resources
summary: Fetch an available resource, mark it unavailable during use, mark it available after (phone numbers for outbound calls).
steps: Fetch available | Mark busy | Use | Release
jarvis_use: Locks for browser tab, live surface or device once Jarvis runs parallel work.

name: Throttle bulk actions
summary: Unthrottled bulk email melted on-prem servers; rate-limit any bulk operation and don't assume an abstraction does it.
steps: Identify bulk ops | Add rate limit
jarvis_use: Rate-limit bulk shell/network loops.

name: Separate logging pipe (session-end event only)
summary: Point the assistant's server URL at a webhook and enable only the end-of-call report, keeping logging apart from action tools.
steps: Webhook POST | Set server URL | Only end-of-call report
jarvis_use: Logging as its own pipe subscribed to job-end.

name: Separate memory write and read paths
summary: Build RAG ingest and query as two pipelines; validate ingest with a gold question before building query.
steps: Ingest pipeline | Gold question test | Query pipeline
jarvis_use: Memory writes and reads testable separately.

name: Prune by known constraints before choosing
summary: Turing's Bombe used guessed fragments to eliminate contradicting settings in bulk, leaving a short list for humans.
steps: Known fragment | Drop contradictions | Hand over short list
jarvis_use: Prune candidates with known constraints before asking a model or Evens.

name: Expert-system failure mode
summary: Hand rules work for narrow stable jobs but grow fragile: conflicts and maintenance load signal a switch to learned/model handling.
steps: Use rules narrowly | Watch rule count/conflicts
jarvis_use: Consistent with Jarvis's no-phrase-routes rule.

name: Account-adjacent actions = confirm first
summary: Saved logins, always-allow send, execute-any workflows and live calendar writes are treated like money transfers: human before the write.
steps: Classify surface | Gate account-adjacent writes
jarvis_use: Safari login walls go to Evens; send/pay/delete held for OK.

name: Router file imported by every harness
summary: Keep AGENTS.md identical to CLAUDE.md or import it with @AGENTS.md so one source drives all harnesses; point others to memory.md.
steps: One source file | Import line in others
jarvis_use: Jarvis re-reads AGENT_RULES/JARVIS_CONTEXT each turn from one source.

name: Global vs project scope for rules, skills and agents
summary: User-level ~/.claude holds cross-project preferences; repo .claude/ holds project-shared ones; move files between scopes as needed.
steps: Personal in user scope | Project in repo scope | Move as needed
jarvis_use: Global operator rules vs per-project packs; no secrets in shared scope.

name: One git-backed root with nested projects
summary: One OS root pushed to GitHub, nested CLAUDE.md per subproject, frequently used projects in an other-worlds folder so one push/pull syncs machines.
steps: Root repo | Nested context files | Other-worlds folder
jarvis_use: Index sibling projects under one root; respect isolation of shared repos.

name: Internal facts vs deliverable repo
summary: Client facts live in the OS; deliverables are a separate repo the OS references by path.
steps: clients/<name> facts | Separate deliverable repo | Route by path
jarvis_use: Job facts in memory, deliverables referenced by path.

name: System-upgrade registry with dedupe
summary: Harness lessons tracked as rows UNTESTED -> WIRED (skill+funnel+hook) -> DRY-RUN PASS; duplicates map to one canonical ID; WIRED is not accepted.
steps: Write candidate row | Map duplicates | Wire | Dry-run fixtures
jarvis_use: Single registry of Jarvis harness upgrades; dedupe before adding.

name: Build the factory first / primitives registry
summary: Build reusable primitives (login, payments, share) before a single product; registry status stub/wired_untested/connected, connected only after verifier grade; payments stay stub until owner says.
steps: Find repeated needs | Build primitives | Register status | Verifier grade to connected
jarvis_use: When a task type repeats, extract reusable procedures before one-offs.

name: Thin adapter over existing code; don't fake gaps
summary: Wrap existing auth with a thin adapter exposing the primitive interface, keep UI unchanged, record missing handlers instead of inventing them.
steps: Read existing code | Write adapter | Leave UI | Record gaps
jarvis_use: Adapt via thin wrappers and report missing pieces.

name: Graph engineering / per-step micro-loops
summary: Wire several AIs as a team graph; give each step its own trigger/check/log loop; the speaker calls it usually overkill; one source is a truncated post.
steps: Split into steps | Per-step check and log | Connect
jarvis_use: Add per-step checks only where a step fails often; fan-out only after Jev preflight.

name: Shared connectors, isolated per-lane computers
summary: Connectors and skills are shared across agents once connected; each agent keeps its own computer/browser session with persisted logins.
steps: Connect once | Share skills | Isolate browser per agent
jarvis_use: MCP connectors global; isolate browser profiles per task lane to limit blast radius.

name: Agent / environment / session / vault split
summary: Hosted agent split into definition, environment (container with networking rules), session, and credential vault; each agent gets its own environment.
steps: Create agent | Create environment with network rules | Start session | Connect services via vault | Test
jarvis_use: Keep the same split for Jarvis jobs; sandbox network not unrestricted by default.

name: Egress allowlist tiers
summary: Cloud environments offer trusted (default), custom domains, full, none; full raises prompt-injection exfiltration risk, so prefer custom with named domains.
steps: Start trusted | Add named domains | Full only knowingly
jarvis_use: Unattended Jarvis egress defaults to an allowlist; widening needs a named domain and Evens's OK.

name: Hosted runner for always-on jobs
summary: Write automations as code tasks locally and host them on a runner (Trigger.dev) with schedules, retries and queues so they run with the laptop off.
steps: Describe automation | Write tasks | Link project | Test dev | Deploy prod (approval)
jarvis_use: Raise hosting as an explicit approval question instead of assuming the Mac stays awake.

name: Secrets in host env, var named in the prompt
summary: Remote runs don't get a gitignored .env; bulk-import env vars into the host for dev and prod, and tell the prompt to use the env var rather than hunt for .env.
steps: Add vars to host env | Select environments | Name var in prompt | Re-run
jarvis_use: Only relevant if Jarvis jobs move to hosted runners; first check host env on auth errors.

name: Git-push deploy behind approval
summary: Agent inits git, creates private repo, pushes with .env excluded; host (Vercel/Trigger.dev) auto-deploys on tracking-branch push; rule: test local first, push only when told.
steps: Private repo | Push excluding secrets | Connect host | Local-first rule | Push only on approval
jarvis_use: Jarvis preps branch/PR; deploy-triggering push is Tier-3 for Evens.

name: Dark-factory autonomy levels
summary: Levels from autocomplete to spec-only; level 3 (agent writes, human plans and validates) recommended until the harness (queue, separate reviewer, hold-outs, deploy) is proven.
steps: Know levels | Stay at 3 | Engineer harness | Spec as interface
jarvis_use: Jarvis operates at level 3; autonomy rises only with a proven validation harness.

name: Merge is not ship (blue-green)
summary: If merged PRs never reach users you built a PR generator; deploy to standby then flip traffic.
steps: Two copies | Deploy standby | Flip | Old live becomes standby
jarvis_use: Label merged, standby and live separately; the flip is Evens's step.

name: Dumb front end, webhook back end with field contract
summary: Build the capture UI in a builder, POST to a webhook on button click with an explicit list of fields; all logic in the workflow; nothing is stored until wired.
steps: Build page | Webhook POST | Tell front end which fields | Listen and submit
jarvis_use: If Jarvis builds a capture page, keep it dumb and prove one POST lands with expected fields.

name: Respond-to-webhook for inline results
summary: Set the webhook to respond via a Respond node so the front end waits and renders the result instead of emailing it (named, not built).
steps: Respond mode | Add respond node | Front end waits and renders
jarvis_use: Return results to the caller when they should see them inline.

name: Native provider tools via Responses API
summary: Enabling the Responses API on the chat model node unlocks built-in web search, file search and code interpreter without separate tool nodes.
steps: Enable Responses API | Pick built-in tool
jarvis_use: Before adding a search tool, check whether the Jev-routed provider offers native tools.

name: Persistent voice socket owned by one service
summary: Leaving the playground needs function definitions in code and a persistent server process holding the Live API websocket.
steps: Read Live API docs | Define functions | Run persistent process
jarvis_use: Jarvis voice path: one long-lived socket owned by one service; live :4018 unchanged without Evens.

name: File signal bus between voice and face
summary: Voice writes status notes to a bus directory; face reads it; hands optional; default permission ask.
steps: Define bus_dir | Voice writes | Face reads | Default ask
jarvis_use: Possible decoupling for voice and Face/Orb; live surface change needs Evens's OK.

name: Gemini File Search managed RAG via four HTTP calls
summary: Create store, resumable upload to /files, import into store (store name in path), generateContent with store as the agent's knowledge tool.
steps: Create store | Upload file | Import to store | Query tool
jarvis_use: Only with Evens's approval; default stays owned RAG and no PII upload.

name: Supervisor agent keeps workers working
summary: A central orchestrator whose only job is keeping N worker agents running (claims unverified).
steps: Run workers | One supervisor
jarvis_use: Pattern maps to Watchdog, not a new daemon.

name: A2A protocol for agent-to-agent coordination
summary: MCP connects agents to tools; A2A connects agents to agents with agent cards, a task lifecycle and secure context sharing.
steps: Agent card | Shared lifecycle | Secure context
jarvis_use: Only if Jarvis must coordinate with fleet agents: capability card plus defined task lifecycle.

name: Design AI into team workflows, not raw credits
summary: Handing out raw model credits is unsafe; map team workflows and design where AI plugs in with safe environments.
steps: Map workflows | Design plug-in points | Provide safe environments
jarvis_use: Jarvis wires capabilities into named jobs with guards rather than raw tool access.

name: Plan, ask questions, approve, then execute
evidence: shown in many tapes; Jarvis has ask_owner and approval holds but no enforced plan step
summary: Plan mode first; agent asks clarifying questions, turns a vague idea into a PRD/plan, and the plan is reviewed/approved before any side-effecting execution.
steps: Detect vague or multi-step ask | Ask only result-changing questions | Write plan | Get approval on side-effecting steps | Execute
tools: Claude Code plan mode, Codex plan mode, grill-me skill
jarvis_use: Plan card plus owner approval before side effects.

name: Options with a recommended default and explanation
summary: Present choices as multiple choice with a recommended default and a one-line explanation of each option, instead of auto-picking Recommended.
steps: List options | Mark the recommended one | Explain each in one line
jarvis_use: ask_owner prompts formatted as options with a default.

name: Unknowns check: what am I not thinking of
summary: End planning by asking the model what has been overlooked; the plan includes a things-you-haven't-considered section.
steps: Dump context | Ask what is missing | Fold the risks into the plan
jarvis_use: Standard closing line of Jarvis plan step.

name: Editable plan: annotate and override before accept

tools: Gemini File Search API, Pinecone Assistant, OpenAI vector stores, n8n
jarvis_use: Paid rent under the builder-no-rent rule; prefer local equivalents, and any use needs Evens's OK.

name: Grounded answers with verbatim citations
summary: Answer only from the designated source file. Request verbatim highlights or cite the section, and never present a generated summary as a quote.
tools: Pinecone Assistant API, OpenAI file search, Vapi
jarvis_use: Document answers name file and section; quotes must grep-match the source.

name: Searchable past sessions with progressive retrieval
summary: Store sessions in SQL or full-text search. Search the index first, then a timeline around hits, then full detail only where needed. Keep a viewer so the memory can be audited.
jarvis_use: Index Jarvis transcripts in SQLite FTS and search them instead of stuffing history into the prompt.

name: Typed state store, one key at a time
summary: Durable facts and run logs go in a typed JSON store written through a CLI. Only one key is loaded into the prompt. IDs are monotonic and no secrets are stored.
jarvis_use: Job state lives in typed keys; load only the needed key.

name: User and business profile loaded each session
summary: user.md (who, preferences) and memory.md or profile JSON (environment, business facts). Written once on cue and updated over time, never re-asked. Holds no secrets and no in-flight status.
jarvis_use: One small profile of Evens and his businesses loaded per turn, updated via proposals.

name: Onboarding brain-dump
summary: Talk to the agent for 5-10 minutes about goals, team and projects so it writes its profile and memory files.
jarvis_use: Voice ramble intake distilled into profile proposals.

name: Per-project AGENTS.md with operating rules
summary: Each project carries AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md with the user context, goal, folder layout and operate rules (tools first, error loop). It loads only when working there; global identity files stay separate.
jarvis_use: Read the repo's AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md when a job targets that repo.

name: Edit-diff to preference rules
summary: When the owner edits a draft, list each change and the reason, then update the instructions or workflow file. Record what was good too, and collect exemplars of taste.
jarvis_use: Diff Evens's edit against Jarvis's draft and propose preference rules.

name: Save runbook, tool and recipe after first success
summary: After a run succeeds, save the script and a markdown workflow (objective, inputs, steps, edge cases). Save integration recipes (endpoint, auth by key location, defaults) and accepted style presets. Keep an SOP prompt repository by role, and revise a prompt when its output degrades.
tools: Claude Code, Python, Tavily, Claude Design
jarvis_use: Extend procedural memory to save the working script and a runbook card, not only a summary.

name: Memory consolidation, lint and coverage pass
summary: A periodic, capped pass that prunes contradictions, merges duplicates, converts relative dates to absolute, finds gaps and suggests links. Output is proposals, not rewrites.
jarvis_use: Weekly memory tidy as diffs for review; one capped pass.

name: Layered memory: facts, index, rules, wiki
summary: One fact per file with a memory.md index, a separate rules file, and a deep wiki that is never autoloaded. Other harnesses are routed to the same memory file.
jarvis_use: Separate learned facts from rules; wiki only on demand.

name: Hot cache file
summary: A tiny hot.md of the latest context, read before the index and deeper search.
jarvis_use: Tiny-active CURRENT_STATE serves this role; read it first each job.

name: Evergreen ingest, live fetch, freshness labels
summary: Ingest only data still useful in a year. Fetch live data (mail, chat, counts) when it is used. After a stale miss, trace the fact to its file and re-sync after idle periods.
jarvis_use: Re-fetch changing numbers before stating them; mark cached facts with a date.

name: Ordered lookup cascade
summary: For vague questions, search the project file, then the wiki, then transcripts, then the live tool as a last resort.
jarvis_use: Encode the lookup order in the router file.

name: Recall over read-only comms connectors
summary: Personal AI OS that can query meetings, videos, Slack, ClickUp and email on demand.
jarvis_use: MCP reads exist; keep them read-only, and sends stay behind approval.

name: Privacy gate for memory processing
summary: Classify data as OK or not OK for a hosted vendor. Route sensitive data to local models or keep it out of the hosted brain.
jarvis_use: Jev picks tiers but needs a sensitivity tag that forces local or excluded routing.

name: Own-voice exemplar corpus
summary: Export and curate your own past work (tweets, emails, call transcripts, SOPs). Read a sample, read-only, before building or drafting. Small personal data is the moat.
jarvis_use: Curated folder of Evens's own writing loaded before any draft in his voice.

name: Local reference and playbook docs
summary: Turn often-used vendor docs or deep research into local markdown guides (docs/), tagged into ideation instead of re-fetching.
jarvis_use: Cache docs with source URL and fetch date; read before browsing.

name: One folder per job with README and run log
summary: projects/<job> for each piece of work. Inputs are kept apart from generated outputs, internal experiments apart from deliverables, plus a record/ log. Add a guide or index when the folder gets large.
jarvis_use: Every Jarvis job gets a folder with inputs/, outputs/, ledger and README.

name: Dated decision log and quarterly priorities
summary: The agent appends each big decision with a date. A current-quarter project file holds statuses and is routed from the root file.
jarvis_use: Append Evens's big calls to a dated decisions file; keep the quarter priorities loaded.

name: Open flags routed to the real owner
summary: Unknown or second-hand facts are logged as open flags with who to ask, then filled in when the answer comes back. They are never guessed.
jarvis_use: ask_owner exists; also persist OPEN items with owner in the ledger.

name: Coverage-gap card instead of inventing
summary: With zero learned procedures for a domain, stop that task, write a gap card listing only transferable patterns, and wait for a real source.
jarvis_use: Say 'no stored procedure', name the nearest transferable ones, do not improvise.

name: Desk or role wiki read before work
summary: Capture each role's responsibilities, workflows and owns/never boundaries in a wiki or job card. Read it before running any workflow.
jarvis_use: Jarvis reads AGENT_RULES every turn; add its own job card with owns/never at job start.

name: Workflow-compiler card
summary: Fixed card per learned source: Classify, Decompose, Coverage map, narrow Retrieve, then Steps. Each step carries IF, Do, skill, support and dissent ids, valid_when, confidence and a transcript pointer. The card ends with audits and an operate-never list.
jarvis_use: Use as the procedural-memory format for learned methods; Jarvis does not load these cards yet.

name: Five-layer knowledge store
summary: Raw, atoms, graph (with mismatches and behaviors), patterns, and workflows. Every compiled workflow traces back through patterns and atoms to the transcript.
jarvis_use: Exists in Outer Heaven; Jarvis should cite atoms and raw when it uses a procedure.

name: One steal catalog keyed by source id
summary: Merge every extracted steal into one master sheet with source and cluster tags. No per-source forks; themes are canonized by the Librarian.
jarvis_use: Jarvis's own ingestion appends to the one catalog and dedupes by source id.

name: Do not flatten; keep dissent visible
summary: Merge lessons only when conditions, goals and contexts match. Opposing guidance stays as sibling views with dissent ids and is never averaged.
jarvis_use: Memory consolidation refuses similarity-only merges and picks by valid_when.

name: Retrieve, compare, condition, synthesize, audit
summary: Retrieved items are compared, filtered by conditions, synthesized and audited, never blended.
jarvis_use: Keep contradictions visible when pulling several memory items.

name: Classify and decompose before retrieving
summary: Write the task class and sub-steps before opening knowledge atoms, so retrieval cannot invent the project.
jarvis_use: State task class and sub-steps before searching memory.

name: Raw-source immutability
summary: Raw transcripts plus metadata are ground truth, referenced by path and never overwritten. No invented visual traces for caption-only sources.
jarvis_use: Raw captures read-only; distilled notes link to them.

name: Atom schema with validation script
summary: One JSON line per atom with required source, conditions, confidence and evidence fields. Written through a validator script and versioned by id.
jarvis_use: Jarvis memory writes go through a schema check.

name: Speech vs behavior mismatch rows
summary: What a source says versus what it does is stored as a first-class row with do_not_resolve set; the approval side is followed.
jarvis_use: When a tutorial says 'approval' but auto-sends, follow the approval side.

name: Ordered behavior sequences with failure branches
summary: Procedures stored as full ordered step chains with failed attempts kept as branches, never compressed into slogans.
jarvis_use: Procedural memory keeps step order and where it failed.

name: Versioned patterns with support, dissent and valid_when
summary: Derived patterns carry support and dissent ids, valid_when and less_relevant_when conditions, confidence and creator counts.
jarvis_use: Rank procedures by support and check valid_when before applying.

name: Creator OS versioning
summary: Track how a creator's advice changes over time as versioned notes, never cloned into an agent personality.
jarvis_use: Note how a source's advice changed instead of adopting it wholesale.

name: Single SSOT tree; archive leftovers
summary: One canonical folder; leftover copies get a pointer README and no new files.
jarvis_use: Write to one canonical memory location only.

name: Separate wiki per growing corpus
summary: Distinct growing corpora (YouTube vs meetings) each get their own wiki and index, so search scope is narrower. Homogeneous logs stay flat; mixed knowledge nests.
jarvis_use: Separate stores for signals, meetings and decisions, each routed from the router file.

name: Co-ingest related sources to surface mismatches
summary: Ingest sources that cite each other together, so the wiki flags incommensurable comparisons such as different baselines or harnesses.
jarvis_use: When comparing vendor claims, ingest both and check baseline and harness.

name: Plain-file, harness-agnostic brain
summary: Knowledge, skills and memory are plain markdown in a git repo that any agent can read. Only a thin per-tool config layer differs, and a new agent is asked to adapt the repo.
tools: GitHub, Claude Code, Codex, Hermes Agent
jarvis_use: ONE-BRAIN files are shared; keep Jarvis procedural memory in the same plain-markdown tree.

name: Keep twin instruction files in sync
summary: After a major edit to CLAUDE.md, a skill or a sub-agent, apply the same change to AGENTS.md and other counterparts.
jarvis_use: Drift check across CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and .mdc; propose a sync, never a silent overwrite.

name: Workspace top-level layout
summary: Root folders such as decisions/, audits/, archives/, brainstorms/, wiki/, projects/, brand assets and 'Other Worlds' for nested projects.
jarvis_use: Mirror in Jarvis's workspace via the router.

name: Markdown vault is the store; Obsidian only views
summary: The brain is the markdown plus routing. Obsidian's graph is optional and gives no retrieval; judge the system by whether the right info comes back.
jarvis_use: Jarvis reads the existing vault files directly; no second vault.

name: Lowest second-brain level that removes the pain
summary: Five levels: router, wiki plus memory, semantic, graph, always-on. Build the knowledge layer before automations, climb only on real pain, and set the level per folder.
jarvis_use: Stay at router plus wiki; record the logged failure that justifies any upgrade.

name: Design storage from the future question
summary: Write the recall questions first, and what a careful human would look at to answer them, then choose folder or retrieval shape. The agent can be asked to propose the shape.
jarvis_use: Before a new memory store, list the queries it must answer.

name: Find-time pulse check
summary: If the agent searches a long time for a file you could find by hand, restructure the tree.
jarvis_use: Log lookup time and tokens per file fetch; flag slow lookups.

name: Re-grill on process change
summary: Reopen a saved capture doc and run a delta interview when the process changes.
jarvis_use: Update the matching capture doc instead of starting over.

name: Speaker-block transcript cleanup
summary: Print the speaker label only on a speaker change and output the attendee list. Compacts transcripts before storage.
jarvis_use: Normalize meeting and voice transcripts in the ingestion step.

name: Ingest-then-name files
summary: File the dropped asset in a known folder and ask for a meaningful name so later lookups by name work.
jarvis_use: Files tool plus ask_owner can do it; make it a habit.

name: Past-work retrieval for deliverables
summary: Search a past-projects store for the closest case study to ground a proposal.
jarvis_use: Ground deliverables in prior work from memory.

name: Explain-on-request (mentor mode)
summary: Ask the agent to explain an action you don't understand.
jarvis_use: say tool already answers; log explanations with the action.

name: Always-on syncing brain
summary: Gbrain-style always-on memory sync under a persistent agent or crons.
jarvis_use: Candidate only; new daemon/scheduler conflicts with rule 19 without a bloat check and Evens's OK.

name: Open-source shared brain repo
summary: A creator released an 'open brain' repo and a community builds on it.
jarvis_use: Reference only, after a repo install gate check (URL not given).

name: Active building over passive watching
summary: Human learning advice: build rather than watch (retention figures are the creator's claim).
jarvis_use: Echoed by the live-match rule; nothing to build.

name: Build-in-public proof library
summary: Record every build and publish demos or case studies somewhere linkable; answer 'what have you built?' with links, not essays.
jarvis_use: Jarvis keeps an index of proof captures and run logs; publishing stays with Evens.

name: Before/after short demo capture
summary: Once a fix works, record about 2 minutes: the old time cost, then the new one-command run.
jarvis_use: The live-match capture for each automation Jarvis ships (AGENT_RULES 13a).

name: Demo video from driving the real UI
summary: Agent clicks through the real product, captures it and cuts fast and voice-over launch variants with music, motion graphics and SFX.
jarvis_use: Computer/Safari captures assembled in FilmCraft/HyperFrames; doubles as live-match evidence.

name: Outcome-labeled proof pack
summary: Public pack names the result (hours back, one walkthrough), not the vehicle; one proof attached; a human publishes.

name: 90-minute one-bottleneck proof
summary: 15 min drawing trigger/steps/done, 60 min rough build, 15 min walkthrough on camera.

name: Per-job outline and Excalidraw diagrams with render check
summary: Agent writes outline, visual plan and Excalidraw diagrams into a per-video folder; import and fix layout overlaps.

name: Evens supplies the idea; Jarvis expands or offers angles
summary: Hand off typing, not thinking: the human gives the core idea or reacts to AI-suggested angles; AI adds structure and examples.
jarvis_use: Ask Evens for the thesis before drafting; never invent it.

name: Voice profile from real samples
summary: A style-analyst prompt dissects real writing and transcripts (persona, tone, structure, rhythm, diction, devices) into a reusable profile or playbook that every draft is written against.
steps: Collect Evens's messages, posts and transcripts | Run the detailed style-analysis prompt | Save as a versioned profile skill | Attach to every drafting job
jarvis_use: Needs skills-library loading; procedural memory alone doesn't carry a voice.

name: Newsletter voice blueprint, then a new issue
summary: Extract voice and structure template from past winners, then write a new issue from his idea; learn the style, not the words.

name: Script templates from liked YouTube transcripts
summary: Copy transcripts via 'Show transcript', paste 1-5 with delimiters, extract hook/arc/pacing/CTA template, generate a new long or short script.
jarvis_use: Safari tool can click Show transcript; no own ingestion pipeline yet.

name: Style transfer from an expert transcript
summary: Load an expert's podcast transcript as the style guide for subject lines and bodies.

name: Taste/exemplar library with 'why it's good'
summary: Save exemplars in your voice and ask the AI what makes each clear and trustworthy, rather than copying.
jarvis_use: Exemplar folder; Jarvis cites which exemplar a draft matched.

name: Style + best-practice grounded post
summary: Feed top past posts, platform best-practice articles and the new source; write in that style.

name: Pinned-sources content chat
summary: Pin a YouTube URL (transcript and thumbnail) and a website as sources; ask for takeaways applied to a named brand.

name: AI-phrase kill list lint
summary: A global list of banned phrases and tells for anything written as you; add to it every time an output sounds like AI.
steps: Keep kill list in global rules | Lint every draft before showing | Append new offenders on Evens's feedback
jarvis_use: Needs hooks (missing).

name: Draft-and-review default
summary: AI drafts, the human reviews for accuracy and voice before anything goes out; your name is on it.
jarvis_use: Safari tool already holds send/publish for Evens's OK.

name: Skill-stacked social post and carousel on a cheap tier
summary: Writing skill + no-AI-slop skill on a Sonnet-class model; generate post and carousel PDF.
jarvis_use: Jev routes to mid tier; skills loading missing.

name: Mother sales script from winning calls
summary: Consolidate 10 winning call transcripts into one sectioned script keeping only lines repeated across winners.
jarvis_use: Selling locked (Building mode); the keep-what-repeats pattern is reusable for procedures.

name: Failure clustering (objection playbook analog)
summary: Per failed call extract objections with quotes, then cluster the top recurring ones with root causes and handling lines.
jarvis_use: Apply to failed Jarvis runs: cluster by root cause with quoted evidence.

name: Transcripts to VSL script
summary: Extract persuasion beats from sales calls into a VSL script.

name: Content to lead magnet to follow-up sequence
summary: Turn transcripts into a lead magnet, then an email/SMS sequence to book calls.

name: Warm first-touch outreach prompt
summary: Casual message under 100 words asking for a 20-minute call; no corporate speak.
jarvis_use: Hard locks 1-2.

name: Signal-based personalized email with honest offer
summary: Open on a sourced public signal, tie to outcome, state an honest offer, ask permission to send a short video.

name: Fixed-section document prompt
summary: System prompt with role, objective, constraints (placeholders, no follow-up questions), tone and a fixed section skeleton; refine from observed outputs.

name: Renderer 'preserve text' and pinned theme
summary: Send text to the deck renderer in preserve mode so it formats without rewriting; pin the brand theme by ID.

name: Five-section brief template
summary: Research assistant writes one page: overview, pain points, industry context, approach, questions to ask.

name: Unattended one-goal video build with caps
summary: One /goal prompt researches, scripts and edits a full video or intro unattended, pulling facts from the computer; record time and tokens, check facts, end with a summary of location, length and verification.
steps: One goal with deliverable and stop condition | Time and cost cap via cost meter | Check facts against current sources | End summary with path, length, contents, verification
jarvis_use: Needs resume-after-reboot and an independent verifier.

name: Self-summary video or report as recall audit
summary: Ask the agent to render a journey video or visual recap of the past months from project memory; review for stale facts and blur money figures.

name: Browsable concept map over a transcript corpus
summary: One prompt builds a clickable map of ideas, tools and techniques across all transcripts, with beginner-friendly start paths and source videos.
jarvis_use: Blocked on Jarvis's own signal ingestion.

name: Brand-asset grounding
summary: Keep a brand_assets folder (logo, guidelines), name exact files in the brief, pass them to any delegate (never 'pick a sensible default'), and plan sections before drafting a document.
steps: One canonical brand_assets path | Cite exact paths in every brief | Pass them to delegates | Check output in the browser against the brand

name: Shared design system / tokens
summary: Build a design system from repo and brand files, reuse it for every page or offer type, export a handoff bundle.

name: Local brand-asset reuse
summary: Agent finds the signature and photos in local folders and uses them instead of generating.

name: Frontend-design skill before UI
summary: Install the official frontend-design skill globally; a CLAUDE.md rule invokes it before any front-end code.
jarvis_use: Jarvis has no skills-library loading.

name: Reference library before design
summary: Never prompt 'make it premium': give real sites from Godly, Awwwards and Motion Sites, name the specific elements and signature motion, and say why you like them.

name: Clone a reference or competitor, then rebrand
summary: Full-page screenshot plus computed styles (or have the model inspect a competitor page), clone it, then clear context and apply your brand assets and copy.

name: Frontier tier and 3 motion references for cinematic sites
summary: Use a frontier model on high reasoning for taste work and feed it 3 sites with motion you love.
jarvis_use: Jev already routes tiers; references step not enforced.

name: Three divergent versions from one reference screenshot
summary: Attach a reference, use the design skill to make three divergent versions, compare them in a browser and pick one.

name: Cheap previews, human pick, then final render
summary: Generate a few low-res or styled variants, save to the media folder, wait for the human's pick, then render the high-res or video final.
steps: N cheap proofs (ArtCraft first) | ask_owner for pick | Quote paid final and get OK | Render and log; discard extras

name: Label unrequested attempts as secondary
summary: When the agent makes extra variants on its own, present the requested path first and mark side attempts lower confidence.

name: Generate, score, select, improve loop
summary: Make N candidates, rubric-score, keep top 3, fix each one's weakest part, rescore, iterate the leader.

name: Two brakes: hard cap and human taste
summary: Creative loops stop on a metric or hard cap; taste is judged by the human, and a self-score never marks it done.

name: Logo critique loop, then vector master
summary: Generate several logos, critique them in a loop, hand-vectorize the winner, export sizes and write typography roles.

name: Transcript-synced edit loop with bounds checks
summary: Transcribe footage, cut mistakes and pauses, build and sync beats, render, then check that graphics stay in bounds and line up with the transcript; iterate until they pass.
steps: Transcribe | Cut and set beats | Render | Independent frame and alignment check | Iterate or hand off

name: ffmpeg stitch and word-level timing track
summary: Concatenate clips with ffmpeg, run word-level transcription on the stitched audio, and use the word timestamps as the timing track.
jarvis_use: Shell can run ffmpeg and one ASR at a time; whether the ASR is installed is unverified.

name: Word-timed motion graphics
summary: Map each visual to its trigger phrase and word timestamp, make one designed graphic per explaining beat (HTML/GSAP in HyperFrames), use only on-tape or researched numbers, keep the speaker visible.

name: Animate real sourced data
summary: Gather real numbers and give them with a styled chart prompt instead of a menu animation preset.

name: Named non-default font gate
summary: Default model fonts are the biggest slop tell; always name a font and compare variants.

name: Font from screenshot to free match
summary: Screenshot a design and have the model find the font or closest free alternative from Google Fonts, Fontshare and similar.

name: One icon pack per piece
summary: Download a whole icon pack in one style and give it to the model; never mix styles.

name: Licensed Lottie library
summary: License-checked Lottie JSON animations kept in a library folder shared with the design tool.

name: Generate a still and drop it into a composition
summary: Set aspect and resolution, check credit cost, generate, then tell the design tool where to place it.
jarvis_use: ArtCraft by default; paid generators behind media-gen-cost-gate.

name: Visual concepts before a UI build
summary: Generate dashboard concepts and a logo with an image model first, store them in the project, then build from the data file.

name: Fixed HTML report template
summary: Ship a report-template HTML with the skill and fill it every run so outputs are comparable.

name: Product-locked still, animate, fidelity compare
summary: Attach the real product image with 'do not alter' (public URL for APIs), generate a product-accurate still first, animate it, then compare the final frames' label, font and logo with the source; plain image-to-video mutated the product.
steps: Canonical reference asset + lock instruction | Generate and check still | Animate from still | Last frame beside source for Evens

name: Caption the intermediate output and feed it forward
summary: A vision model describes the generated image; the description goes into the next (video) prompt for consistency.

name: Sectioned prompt-expansion agent, tuned per use case
summary: A prompt-writer agent with sectioned guidelines (subject, setting, camera, lighting, product accuracy) and 'output only the prompt', specialized per use case (e.g. UGC).

name: Video prompt with visual direction and dialogue
summary: One structured prompt carrying framing, style, specs, matching to the reference image, and the spoken line.

name: Prompt craft in the caller; media tools stay dumb
summary: No AI inside media subflows; the calling agent holds the prompt rules and the subflow just executes the API call.

name: Per-model media restrictions memory
summary: Sora 2 rejects realistic-human reference images and shows the source still in the first frame (crop it); Veo accepts people. Record and route accordingly.
jarvis_use: Procedural memory can hold it once seen.

name: Test prompts in a playground before the API
summary: Try prompts in the vendor playground before automating.

name: Don't grade a model on a thin prompt
summary: A one-line prompt gives junk; compare raw against expanded prompts before judging the model.

name: Cameos via public username
summary: Put a public Sora cameo username in the prompt; stricter rejections.
jarvis_use: Likeness use only with Evens's consent.

name: Storyboard duration check and long timeout
summary: Scene durations must sum to the total; expect long runs and occasional 500s.

name: Async poll, sanitize, frame-0 gate
summary: Poll async generation until success, strip newlines and curly quotes from JSON bodies, write back by unique key, one row at a time, inspect frame 0.

name: Resolve the named source file, then edit
summary: Find the exact file ID or path from memory or search, pass the original and prompt to the edit/combine tool, save the result with a descriptive name and return its link.

name: Text legibility stop
summary: Pass only if a stranger can read on-image or on-pack text; if garbled, fix the source or use a simplified label rather than re-rolling.

name: Product-in-scene ad prompt
summary: 'Photorealistic advertisement of <product>, held in front of <landmark>'.

name: Chain media tools as a pipeline
summary: Image output passed to an image-to-video workflow attached as a tool.

name: Scheduled ideas into brand-voice drafts
summary: A schedule runs an idea generator for the target audience, then writes content in brand voice; it stops at drafts.
jarvis_use: Not a new scheduler (rule 19); would go through the existing one if ever wanted.

name: Specific positive examples over snark
summary: Answer negativity with specific, verifiable examples; label unverified figures as claimed.

name: Taste as a deliberate zag
summary: Find the default everyone does and choose a deliberate opposite that fits the insight.

name: Ten boring questions ranked by demand
summary: List 10 recurring questions, rank by search demand, script the first in your voice.

name: Time-machine letter script
summary: Write your biggest decision as advice to someone the day before it; turn it into a script.

name: Explain-the-system insider gap
summary: Five things insiders think are obvious; script the one an outsider would be angry to learn.

name: Outperformers x competency ideas
summary: Topics outperforming in the market crossed with your topic list, then templated scripts and packaging.

name: Copy proven formats; link in comments
summary: Model hooks and structure on posts or reels already performing, read the draft aloud, put the URL in comments, keep posting cadence.

name: Video to platform article draft with frame grabs
summary: From a YouTube URL draft an article, grab key frames, make a thumbnail, paste into platform drafts; the human publishes.
jarvis_use: Safari can fill drafts; frame extraction needs signal ingestion.

name: State your stake first
summary: Disclose tools used, financial ties and insider info before giving a take.

name: Hold the best item to the end
summary: Promise the payoff list up front and say the most valuable item comes last.

name: Teach one tool at a time
summary: Keep teaching on one core tool for a stretch instead of flooding with options.

name: Layered parallax hero
summary: Separate named planes moving at different scroll rates, repeated at the CTA.

name: Product-in-use demo animations
summary: Animate the product working inside apps the audience already uses, with before/after transforms.

name: Sticky nav and reveal micro-interactions
summary: Fixed navbar, text that reveals on entering the viewport, subtle mouse-reactive depth.

name: Seven-principle anti-slop site checklist
summary: Brand guidelines, pain/person/promise, scroll feedback, named inspiration, existing components, mobile check, screenshot-verify scroll.

name: CTA-before-scroll roast
summary: One primary CTA above the fold, repeated after proof, in a color used nowhere else; fail buried CTAs.

name: Scroll-scrub site from one continuous plate
summary: Generate one continuous short 720p shot (reject stitched clips), split it into frames, map scroll position to frame index, show a poster for reduced motion, verify the preview; deploy is the principal's step.

name: Two AI frames to clip to scrollable hero
summary: Two keyframes, Seedance image-to-video between them, then an LLM wraps the clip into an immersive scroll page.

name: Pose/depth previs before a render
summary: Turn reference film shots into pose or depth previs and feed it to the video model before the long render.

name: Offline plate vs interactive world classifier
summary: Ask: finite diffusion clip or steerable next-frame world? Plates go to cinematic skills; worlds go to research or an ask to Evens.

name: Motion stack checklist
summary: Still, animate, upscale, edit/grade, timing help; map each stage to owned tools before paying.

name: Reference to editable vector layers
summary: Vendor plugin decomposes a reference into animatable vector layers and localizes projects.
jarvis_use: EffectCraft/VectorCraft MCPs instead.

name: Video rendered through an MCP, no editor
summary: Connect the model to a video MCP and render animated videos from chat.
jarvis_use: FilmCraft/EffectCraft MCP or HyperFrames via mcp/shell; save to ~/Movies.

name: Title audit with click and SEO scores
summary: Score a title for click and SEO, get 5 rewrites, keyword first, hook after, check fit with the thumbnail.

name: Transcript to SEO description

jarvis_use: Procedural memory stores paths, preferences and must-includes.

name: Export frontier judgment as a skill
summary: Prompt a frontier model to write a complete installable skill that makes a cheaper model run with its judgment, planning, verification and reasoning habits, activated by a mode name.
steps: Prompt the frontier model with the export request | Review the file | Load it in mid-tier runs on hard tasks
jarvis_use: A 'careful mode' skill for Jev's cheap and mid tiers.

name: Custom planning skill
summary: Skip built-in plan mode and use an owned planning skill that sets how to question the user, how to research, and fixed plan sections.
steps: Write questioning instructions | Write research instructions | Define plan sections | Invoke it instead of plan mode
jarvis_use: Model-independent plan format for Jarvis jobs.

name: Hooks that propose skill and rule improvements
summary: A session-end hook asks the agent to propose improvements to rules or skills for review.
steps: Hook on session end | Propose one improvement | Human reviews and applies
jarvis_use: Needs hooks (missing). The job-end proposal is never auto-applied.

name: Read-only self-audit skill
summary: Reads the whole project, checks routing and index claims against disk, writes a dated report to audits/ with grouped fixes and 'await approval', and never fixes anything itself.
steps: Check earlier reports in audits/ | Run the checks | Write the report including 'knowledge current through' and 'what would be wrong today' | List grouped fixes; wait for yes or no
jarvis_use: Weekly read-only audit of Jarvis routing and memory files.

name: Inbox-triage skill, brief first
summary: Built with skill-creator: check the inbox is reachable, scope it (batch 25-30, brief only, categories high/action/ignore), learn sender rules from corrections, and only after confirmation mark the ignore bucket read. Autonomy grows after many tested runs.
steps: Scope with questions | Read-only brief | Correct and save sender rules | Confirm, then act | Write the confirmed step into the skill
jarvis_use: Safari already holds destructive buttons; add the read-only-first mail procedure.

name: Reproduce the result, not the vendor
summary: The goal is the video's result on our own stack. Each vendor shown is mapped to an owned skill, bot or browser tool and listed under operate-never, not installed.
steps: State the outcome | Map each vendor to an owned tool | Drop vendor installs
jarvis_use: Copied methods run on shell, Safari, MCP and Jev, with no paid tools added.

name: Teach-a-task by demonstration
summary: Record yourself doing the task on the agent's computer, and the tool converts the recording into a named skill that can be edited and run as a slash command.
steps: Start the recording | Perform the task | Generate the skill | Edit name, description and steps | Run via /name
jarvis_use: Capture Evens's demonstration and distill it into a semantic-step procedure.

name: Multi-persona research (storm)
summary: Persona sub-agents (academic, skeptic, practitioner, economist, historian) research a question, and a second set revises it. The HTML report has a 60-second summary, findings tagged by supporting or challenging personas, a hidden connection, the underlying assumption and actions.
steps: /goal storm research on X | Spawn persona gatherers | Run a revision pass | Write the report
tools: storm research skill, Claude Code sub-agents
jarvis_use: Needs sub-agents (missing); cheap-tier gatherers plus a critic.

name: Roast council before building
summary: /roast asks 3 intake questions (buyer, edge, constraints), runs 5 persona sub-agents, and a judge returns green, reshape or kill with scores, risk, upside, a money read and the cheapest 48h test.
steps: Intake questions | 5 persona sub-agents in parallel | Judge verdict | Cheapest 48h test
jarvis_use: Devil's-advocate check before builds; needs sub-agents. The 48h test must not involve outreach while in building mode.

name: Portable skill folders across harnesses
summary: Skills transfer between Claude (.claude), Codex (.codex) and others (.agents) if they sit in each harness's folder. Install funnels into every agent's skills path.
steps: Learn each harness's folder | Symlink one source library | Test invocation
jarvis_use: One skill source shared by Jarvis and the fleet.

name: Invoke skills by natural language
summary: Saying 'run a storm research on X' invokes the skill without a slash command; confirm the harness reports it loaded.
steps: Name the skill in plain language | Confirm it loaded
jarvis_use: Evens's spoken requests match skills by description.

name: Front-load extraction
summary: Pay the interview cost up front (even a full business grill) so the first skill draft starts near the top. The quality percentages are the speaker's claim and unverified.
steps: Full grill before writing | Build from the captured doc | Keep iterating
jarvis_use: Interview pass before a new procedure.

name: Onboarding-interview first run
summary: A starter repo's onboarding skill interviews the user, prompts tool connections and audits them.
steps: Run onboarding | Answer the interview | Connect tools | Review the audit
jarvis_use: Pattern for a first-run interview that fills context and lists missing connectors; do not install the vendor repo.

name: Brainstorm skill before build
summary: Use an existing brainstorming skill (Superpowers) in plan mode before building.
steps: Install the skill pack | Run brainstorming in plan mode
jarvis_use: Call an existing brainstorm procedure instead of improvising one.

name: Phase-0 scoping inside a skill
summary: If the topic is vague, the skill first frames topic, reader and decision, or asks, before launching.
steps: Check specificity | Infer or ask reader and decision | Launch
jarvis_use: State the inferred goal; ask_owner only when it changes the result.

name: Tailor research skill to the business
summary: Add business context and goals to the research skill and require a 'what we do differently' section.
steps: Add context | Require an actions section | Test on a known topic
jarvis_use: Research reads Evens's current priorities.

name: Portable project setup file
summary: One md (for example a WAT claude.md) defines the layers, how to operate, the self-improvement loop and the file structure, and is dropped into every new project. A single setup md lets another agent replicate a project.
steps: Write the template | Drop it into the new folder | Agent reads it and sets up the project
jarvis_use: Standard Jarvis operating file and per-capability rebuild md.

name: Agent reads docs to write front matter
summary: Point the agent at the official docs, state capabilities and restrictions, and let it generate correct front matter.
steps: Fetch the docs | State the allowed and denied tools | Generate the front matter
jarvis_use: web_fetch current docs before generating configs.

name: Skill vs plugin classification
summary: A skill only teaches one job. A plugin can bundle skills plus hooks and MCP servers that change runtime behavior, so check what it registers before installing.
steps: Classify as instructions or runtime-changing | Review the hooks and MCP of plugins
jarvis_use: Runtime-changing installs need a review gate.

name: Tool and skill inventory
summary: A catalog skill lists locally installed CLIs and the ones available to install.
steps: Ask which CLIs exist | List the installed ones | List the installable ones
jarvis_use: Inventory before choosing a tool; shell can do it today.

name: Until-condition commands
summary: Package a domain job with a built-in stop condition (for example debug until tests pass) instead of step prompts. This is the speaker's prediction.
steps: Pick a repeated job | Define the stop condition | Package it as a skill
jarvis_use: The operator loop exists; add skill-level stop conditions.

name: Package expertise with evals and connectors
summary: Bundle an expert's steps, good and bad examples, an evaluation loop and data connectors as a skill or plugin. Predicted as a 'context app store'.
steps: Extract the steps | Write good and bad examples | Add a check and connectors | Bundle
jarvis_use: Evens's processes saved with examples and a check.

name: Small skills chained into systems
summary: Build narrow skills that each save minutes, fire them and return to other work, and chain them into orchestrated systems instead of mega-skills.
steps: Split into small skills | Run in background | Chain into a pipeline
jarvis_use: Composable procedures run as background jobs.

name: Thin skill that routes to playbooks, scripts and sub-agents
summary: A master SKILL.md reads a playbook and decision files as needed, runs bundled scripts, uses assets and calls sub-agents in sequence.
steps: Keep a thin master file | Reference large files on demand | Bundle scripts and assets | Delegate heavy steps
jarvis_use: Structure for big Jarvis procedures; delegation waits on sub-agents.

name: Curated small library (20-30)
summary: Cap the library at about 20-30 curated skills with progressive disclosure instead of hoarding marketplaces.
steps: Cap active skills | Use progressive disclosure
jarvis_use: Small active procedure set.

name: Parameterized data sources
summary: Find problems that stay the same across clients while only the data sources change; build once, then adapt by swapping sources.
steps: Build for yourself | Separate fixed pattern from varying sources | Swap sources
jarvis_use: Skills take source parameters.

name: Offer distinct options, let Evens pick
summary: Ask for 2+ distinctly different variants (with a constraint like 'subtle but premium'), or a menu of insert points and treatments, and let the user pick before building.
steps: Load skill and refs | Generate distinct variants or a menu | User picks | Refine and verify
jarvis_use: Present options via ask_owner; asset spend still gated.

name: Closed vocabulary in tool schemas
summary: Equality filters are not semantic, so list exact valid values and date formats in the prompt or schema and update them when categories change.
steps: Enumerate stored values | Specify the format | Update on change
jarvis_use: Enums in Jarvis tool schemas prevent silent zero matches.

name: LLM-drafted prompts with tool-usage rules
summary: Have an LLM draft an agent's system prompt from its role, goal and tools. Check that each tool has a when-to-use line, and inspect the end of runs for issues.
steps: Describe role, goal and tools | Get a draft | Lint the tool-usage rules | Test the tail of runs
jarvis_use: Drafts for future sub-agent and skill prompts, treated as drafts.

name: Script-beat motion skill
summary: Reads the timed transcript, picks moments where animation helps, researches supporting stats, generates graphics and optionally inserts them into the video.
steps: Get the transcript | Pick moments | Research stats | Make graphics | Save or insert
jarvis_use: Depends on signal ingestion (missing); ArtCraft or HyperFrames for graphics; insertion stays HITL.

name: Match advice to workload
summary: Do not blanket-apply advice from harness builders or YouTubers; take it from people whose workload matches yours and test first.
steps: Identify the advisor's workload | Compare with yours | Test before applying
jarvis_use: Tag signal-derived methods with source context in the ingestion pipeline.

name: Periodic delete-and-observe
summary: About every 6 months, run without CLAUDE.md, skills and hooks to see what the model does unaided, and re-add only what is needed.
steps: Run without instructions in isolation | Observe | Re-add what is needed
jarvis_use: Only as an isolated A/B experiment; hive skills are never deleted without Evens.

name: Reference image to motion via vendor MCP
summary: Bookmark claim: a Claude skill takes a reference image, generates frames with Nano Banana 2 and animates them with Seedance 2.0 through the Arcads MCP. Two corpus entries are the same post.
steps: Paste the reference | Generate frames | Animate via MCP
jarvis_use: Pattern only: chain the image and video steps through ArtCraft; no vendor purchase.

name: Run the template, trace each step
summary: Import the workflow, follow the setup note, run it once, then inspect each node's real input and output.
steps: Import | Set up | Run once | Inspect each step
jarvis_use: Run a new repo or workflow once and trace it before modifying.

name: Explain to consolidate
summary: Build the use case yourself and explain it live; explaining makes it stick.
steps: Get ideas | Build | Explain
jarvis_use: After a new method, write a short explanation into memory.

name: Calculator tool for math
summary: LLMs are weak at arithmetic, so attach a compute tool and check the trace shows it was used.
steps: Find arithmetic steps | Use the compute tool | Check the trace
jarvis_use: Jarvis computes via shell or Python.

name: Route per step, not per job
summary: Break a job into steps and pick a model or tool for each step; not every step needs AI, and the whole day should not run on one model.
steps: Split the job into baby steps | Label each step's role (gather/plan/execute/judge/polish) | Ask Jev for a tier or tool per step | Leave non-AI steps non-AI
tools: Perplexity, Claude Code, GPT Image 2, Nano Banana, DaVinci Resolve
jarvis_use: Jev returns a tier per step role instead of once per job.

name: Expensive orchestrator, cheap workers (manager/worker, model-as-teacher)
summary: The frontier model only plans, delegates, worries and reviews; cheaper sub-agents execute, research and verify, then report back. This keeps the orchestrator's context and spend small. The sources' token and cost figures are claims.
steps: Tell the orchestrator it must not execute, only delegate | Fan work out to cheaper worker models | Workers return summaries only | Orchestrator reviews and sends weak work back | Compare against an all-frontier run before trusting the split
tools: Claude Code subagents, dynamic workflows, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku
jarvis_use: Main loop on frontier for plan and review; sub-agents on cheap or mid tier; per-role token log.

name: Plan / critique / execute on different models
